# Metadata fixtures

The corpus for issue #10, used by `MetadataRoundTripTests.swift` through the
`Fixture` helper in `MetadataFixtures.swift`.

**Every file is synthetic.** They are generated by
`Scripts/make-metadata-fixtures.swift` (run `swift Scripts/make-metadata-fixtures.swift`
from the repo root): a drawn 64 × 48 test card — red top-left, green top-right,
blue bottom-left, yellow bottom-right, grey disc in the centre — with
placeholder names and GPS at 0°N 0°E ("Null Island"). No camera, no ComfyUI or
A1111 install, and no personal data were involved. Regenerating may change
bytes between macOS releases (ImageIO's encoders); the contents below should not.

| File | Carries |
|---|---|
| `camera-exif-gps-thumbnail.jpg` | EXIF (lens make/model, exposure time, f-number, ISO, focal length, original/digitised date), TIFF tags (make, model, software, date), GPS IFD (lat/long 0, altitude 0, date/time stamp), EXIF IFD1 JPEG thumbnail. No IPTC, no XMP packet. |
| `iptc-xmp.jpg` | IPTC IIM in APP13 (caption, keywords, credit, copyright, byline, city) and one XMP packet in APP1: `xmp:Rating`, `xmp:Label`, `xmp:CreatorTool`, mirrors of the IPTC fields (`dc:description`, `dc:rights`, `dc:creator`, `dc:subject`, `photoshop:City`, `photoshop:Credit`) and a GPS mirror (`exif:GPSLatitude` / `exif:GPSLongitude`). No EXIF, no GPS IFD. |
| `rotated-orientation-6.jpg` | Orientation 6 in IFD0. Stored 64 × 48, displays 48 × 64 with red top-right. |
| `display-p3.heic` | Display P3 ICC profile, 8-bit. |
| `16-bit.tiff` | 16 bits per channel RGB, LZW, sRGB profile. |
| `cmyk.jpg` | Four-component CMYK JPEG with the Generic CMYK ICC profile (which is most of its size). |
| `comfyui.png` | `tEXt` `prompt` (API graph: KSampler, CheckpointLoaderSimple, EmptyLatentImage, two CLIPTextEncode wired to the KSampler's `positive` / `negative`, VAEDecode, SaveImage) and `tEXt` `workflow` (the matching UI graph: nodes, links, widget values). |
| `a1111.png` | `tEXt` `parameters`: prompt, negative prompt, `Steps: … Sampler: … CFG scale: …` line. |
| `a1111-usercomment.jpg` | The same parameters in EXIF UserComment. |
| `compressed-text.png` | The ComfyUI graphs again, deflated: `prompt` as `zTXt`, `workflow` as compressed `iTXt`. |

PNG chunks are spliced in after `IHDR` with valid CRCs.

## Where the fixtures fall short of real files

- **Nothing here came out of a camera or a generator.** The layouts are what
  ImageIO writes, not what a given camera firmware, PIL, ComfyUI or A1111
  writes: no MakerNote, no real lens data, tag order and padding differ.
- **`a1111-usercomment.jpg`**: ImageIO writes UserComment with the `ASCII`
  character-code prefix. A1111 itself (via piexif) writes `UNICODE` + UTF-16.
  ImageIO decodes both to the same string, but a byte-level writer test would
  not see the real encoding.
- **`iptc-xmp.jpg`**: the XMP packet is hand-written and replaces the one
  ImageIO derives from the IPTC dictionary. The mirrors are plausible but not
  what Lightroom or Photoshop would emit (no `Iptc4xmpCore`, no digest, no
  packet padding). The GPS mirror has no GPS IFD behind it, yet ImageIO still
  reports a `{GPS}` dictionary for the file, so it shows the `GPS` badge.
- **`camera-exif-gps-thumbnail.jpg`**: the thumbnail is the one ImageIO embeds
  (`kCGImageDestinationEmbedThumbnail`), a JPEG of the same 64 × 48 card, so it
  cannot show a thumbnail that differs from the main image. The file has no XMP
  packet; ImageIO still synthesises `xmp:CreateDate`, `xmp:ModifyDate`,
  `xmp:CreatorTool` and `photoshop:DateCreated` from the TIFF tags, which the
  detector ignores because it looks for the packet itself (issue #22).
- **sRGB JPEGs and PNGs** carry no ICC profile bytes (the PNGs have an `sRGB`
  chunk, the JPEGs EXIF ColorSpace = 1); ImageIO still names the profile
  "sRGB IEC61966-2.1", so they show the `ICC` badge.
- **`cmyk.jpg`**: Generic CMYK, converted naively from the RGB card; not a
  press profile such as FOGRA or SWOP.
- **`display-p3.heic`**: 8-bit, no HDR gain map, no depth, no EXIF.
